title: PROJECT HUB
description: Asrın Global’s Project Hub fuses agile delivery, AI-assisted PMO and model-based systems engineering to fast-track industrial decarbonisation projects from idea to bankable pilot.
details:
Core methods:
• GPT-refined backlog grooming (SCRUM + SAFe hybrid) that cuts story refinement time by 46 %.
• Predictive Kanban analytics: Bayesian cycle-time forecasts with ≤ 4 % MAPE.
• RPA bots syncing Jira↔GitLab↔SAP for zero-touch status reporting.
• Digital-twin sandboxes running real-time co-simulation (FMU 2.0) for energy-, traffic- and waste-flow models.
• ISO 56002-aligned stage-gate PMO with auto-generated risk registers using LLM-extracted hazards.

title: COMMUNICATION
description: Our Communication Hub blends AI narration, multilingual content engines and data-driven stakeholder analytics to deliver high-impact outreach across policy, industry and media.
details:
Signature techniques:
• LLM copy-factory fine-tuned on 12 M technical press releases (BLEU = 0.81).
• RAG pipeline that turns 200-page ESG reports into 90-s explainer videos with auto-edit HEVC rendering.
• BERTopic clustering of 14 social-media streams for sentiment + emergent-theme heat-maps.
• Whisper-Large-V3 servers providing live captioning & translation (28 lang, ≤ 250 ms latency).
• GDPR-safe CRM enrichment via synthetic-data personas and k-anonymity scoring.

title: INNOVATION
description: The Innovation Hub scouts, validates and scales frontier tech through AI-accelerated R&D orchestration and open-innovation programs.
details:
Tool-set:
• GNN-powered TechRadar graph DB tracking 8 000 patents → novelty/risk score in < 120 s.
• 3-day VR Design-Sprint kit with spatial whiteboards + motion-captured ideation analytics.
• MLOps lab auto-trains baseline models on new sensor datasets in 45 min (Kubeflow + DVC).
• ISO 16290 TRL + IRL scoring pipeline auto-populated from lab notebooks via NLP.
• Crowdsourced challenge platform (600+ experts) with quadratic-voting reward pool.

title: GREEN
description: The Green-Tech Lab accelerates carbon-negative materials and energy-positive micro-grids from TRL-4 proof-of-concept to bankable pilot scale.
details:
2025 headline projects & methods:
• Bio-aerogel façade panel (λ = 0.018 W/mK) characterised via transient-plane-source calorimetry; stores 14 kg CO₂-e /m².
• 50 kW perovskite PV roof feeding Li-S battery; digital twin built in COMSOL Multiphysics.
• Hollow-fiber membrane capturing 92 % CO₂ (< €35/t) validated with in-situ FTIR.
Researchers access pyro-GC-MS, −40 → +90 °C chambers and 30 m continuous pilot line.

title: PUBLIC
description: We build transparent, bias-audited AI tools that help cities optimise procurement, simulate urban systems and deliver citizen chat services in real time.
details:
Flagship modules & safeguards:
• ProcureLens — NLP engine (RoBERTa-base + LoRA) detecting bid-rigging (F1 = 0.91) with SHAP-based explanation.
• UrbanTwin — digital twin (2 M agents @1 s) using Mesa-RL + GPU particle traffic solver.
• CivicChat — GPT-4-Turbo fine-tuned on 183 k FAQs; DP-SGD for privacy, WCAG 2.2 accessibility.
Quarterly audits: ISO 42001 draft + EN 301 549.

title: SMART
description: Our IoT-powered urban platform merges mobility, energy and safety data to cut congestion, lower emissions and lift liveability scores.
details:
Platform stack:
• Edge: LiDAR counters, OPC-UA energy meters, LTE-Mesh gateways.
• DataOps: Kafka→Flink stream (4.3 M events/min) with Delta Lake time-travel.
• Insight apps: dynamic curb-pricing, demand-response lighting (−47 % kWh) & heat-map routing shaving 19 % travel time.
Open GraphQL + WebSocket API with OAuth 2.1 & JSON-LD schemas.

title: AG

details:

details:
